name.zh: 失败后立刻重试同一小段
name.en: Retry the same short segment immediately

summary.zh: 把失败变成一次有用的练习，下一次只改一个动作。
summary.en: Make failure useful practice: change one action on the next attempt.

rules.zh: 挑战被切成较短的动作段，失败后迅速回到这一段的起点，已经通过的前段不必重做。玩家利用刚看到的失败位置调整起跳或移动时机；当连续动作终于接上，就进入下一段新挑战。
rules.en: Divide a challenge into short action segments. Failure quickly restores the current segment without replaying completed sections. Use the freshly observed failure to adjust a jump or movement timing; completing the sequence advances to the next challenge.

loop.en: Return quickly to the segment start

decisions.zh: 刚才撞上顶棚，这次提前松手，还是改变起跳位置？
decisions.en: After hitting the ceiling, release jump earlier or change where you take off?

decisions.zh: 继续使用接近成功的路线，还是换一条更稳但更慢的走法？
decisions.en: Refine the nearly successful route or try a slower, safer one?

effect.zh: 短段方便把失败归因到一个动作，长段更强调动作的连续稳定性。
effect.en: Short segments isolate a failure to one action; longer ones test consistency across a sequence.

effect.zh: 等待越短越容易保留刚才的动作记忆；过短而缺乏失败提示也可能让原因不清楚。
effect.en: A short delay preserves fresh action memory, but removing failure feedback can obscure the cause.

contrast.zh: 《蔚蓝》把重试放在连续旅途中的小房间里；《超级食肉男孩》更常把一次重试对应到独立短关卡。两者都让学习留在玩家身上，而非依靠每次失败加属性。
contrast.en: Celeste places retries in small rooms within a continuous journey; Super Meat Boy more often maps a retry to a separate short level. Both preserve learning in the player rather than requiring stat gains after failure.

combination.zh: 设计提案：每个短房间只加入一种新障碍规则，失败后保留上一次碰撞位置的短暂标记，帮助玩家提出并验证下一种走法。
combination.en: Design proposal: introduce one new obstacle rule per short room and briefly mark the previous collision point after failure, helping players propose and test a revised route.

setup.zh: 教学示例：一段 8 秒路线包含两次跳跃，第二次起跳太晚会撞锯片。
setup.en: Teaching example: an eight-second section has two jumps; a late second takeoff hits a saw.

action.zh: 第一次失败后，你在段落起点立刻重试，只把第二次起跳提前。
action.en: After failing once, retry from the segment start and change only the second takeoff to occur earlier.

result.zh: 这次通过锯片，失败位置成为可用的信息。
result.en: You clear the saw; the previous failure has supplied useful information.

next.zh: 下一间房移动了落点，你需要形成新的动作顺序。
next.en: The next room relocates the landing, requiring a new sequence.

firstStep.zh: 做三间各 5—10 秒可通过的房间，失败后约半秒恢复操作，并保留清晰的碰撞反馈。
firstStep.en: Build three rooms that each take five to ten seconds to clear; restore control about half a second after failure while preserving clear collision feedback.

pitfall.zh: 重试太快不等于可读性好；隐藏陷阱或不稳定的重置位置仍会让玩家无法学习。
pitfall.en: Fast retries do not guarantee readability; hidden hazards or inconsistent reset positions still prevent learning.

test.zh: 连续记录五次尝试，检查玩家是否改变失败附近的动作，而不是每次从头盲按。
test.en: Record five consecutive attempts; check whether players revise actions near the failure rather than repeating blind inputs from the start.
